# BuildAI Reviews

> Independent, hands-on reviews and comparisons of AI website builders. Every tool is tested with real projects on self-paid subscriptions before being scored. Publishing since 2024.

## Rankings & Reviews
- [Best AI Website Builders in 2026 — Tested & Ranked](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/): Our main ranking of 5 AI builders (Durable, Dorik, Framer, Wix, 10Web) after 60+ hours of testing.
- [Durable AI Review (9.1/10)](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/reviews/durable/): Fastest AI builder — full site from one prompt in under 30 seconds; CRM and invoicing included.
- [Dorik AI Review (8.6/10)](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/reviews/dorik/): Best design quality; white-label and agency features; multilingual AI copy.
- [Framer Review (8.3/10)](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/reviews/framer/): Most powerful design tool; best animations; genuinely usable free plan.
- [Wix AI Review (7.8/10)](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/reviews/wix/): Biggest ecosystem — apps, e-commerce, bookings, SEO tools.
- [10Web Review (7.4/10)](https://lively-platypus-41e843.netlify.app/reviews/10web/): AI building on WordPress with managed hosting and a verified PageSpeed booster.
